cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.
